text.pinyin: Wǒ bàba shì lǎoshī, wǒ māma yě shì lǎoshī, wǒ gēge shì xuéshēng.
text.english: My dad is a teacher, my mum is a teacher too, and my older brother is a student.

text.hanzi: 昨天是星期日，今天是十月一号。
text.pinyin: Zuótiān shì xīngqīrì, jīntiān shì shí yuè yī hào.
text.english: Yesterday was Sunday, and today is the first of October.

text.hanzi: 我女儿今年七岁，我儿子明年七岁。
text.pinyin: Wǒ nǚ'ér jīnnián qī suì, wǒ érzi míngnián qī suì.
text.english: My daughter is seven this year, and my son turns seven next year.

question.english: How old is his son this year?

text.hanzi: 现在是早上七点，我姐姐在睡觉，我哥哥在工作。
text.pinyin: Xiànzài shì zǎoshang qī diǎn, wǒ jiějie zài shuìjiào, wǒ gēge zài gōngzuò.
text.english: It's seven in the morning. My older sister is asleep, and my older brother is working.

text.hanzi: 我下午两点去公司，现在一点半。
text.pinyin: Wǒ xiàwǔ liǎng diǎn qù gōngsī, xiànzài yī diǎn bàn.
text.english: I'm going to the office at two this afternoon. It's half past one now.

text.hanzi: 我早饭吃面包和鸡蛋，不吃米饭。
text.pinyin: Wǒ zǎofàn chī miànbāo hé jīdàn, bù chī mǐfàn.
text.english: For breakfast I have bread and eggs, not rice.

question.english: What does he have for breakfast?

text.hanzi: 我不喝茶，也不喝牛奶，我喝水。
text.pinyin: Wǒ bù hē chá, yě bù hē niúnǎi, wǒ hē shuǐ.
text.english: I don't drink tea or milk. I drink water.

text.hanzi: 这个杯子十五块，那个二十块，我买这个。
text.pinyin: Zhège bēizi shí wǔ kuài, nàge èr shí kuài, wǒ mǎi zhège.
text.english: This cup is fifteen yuan and that one is twenty. I'll buy this one.

question.pinyin: Tā mǎi de bēizi duōshao qián?
question.english: How much is the cup he's buying?

text.hanzi: 这个店卖面包，那个店卖水果。
text.pinyin: Zhège diàn mài miànbāo, nàge diàn mài shuǐguǒ.
text.english: This shop sells bread, and that shop sells fruit.

text.hanzi: 这些书都是新的，是我昨天在书店买的。
text.pinyin: Zhèxiē shū dōu shì xīn de, shì wǒ zuótiān zài shūdiàn mǎi de.
text.english: These books are all new. I bought them at the bookshop yesterday.

question.hanzi: 这些书是他什么时候买的？
question.pinyin: Zhèxiē shū shì tā shénme shíhou mǎi de?
question.english: When did he buy these books?

text.hanzi: 这本书有点儿贵，一百二十块。
text.pinyin: Zhè běn shū yǒudiǎnr guì, yì bǎi èr shí kuài.
text.english: This book is a bit expensive: a hundred and twenty yuan.

text.hanzi: 这个书店很大，新书也很多。
text.pinyin: Zhège shūdiàn hěn dà, xīn shū yě hěn duō.
text.english: This bookshop is big, and it has lots of new books too.

text.hanzi: 这里是我的房间，我哥哥住在那边。
text.pinyin: Zhèlǐ shì wǒ de fángjiān, wǒ gēge zhù zài nàbiān.
text.english: This is my room. My older brother lives over there.

question.english: Where does his older brother live?

text.hanzi: 大卫是美国人，现在住在北京。
text.pinyin: Dàwèi shì Měiguó rén, xiànzài zhù zài Běijīng.
text.english: David is American, and he lives in Beijing now.

text.hanzi: 我明天坐飞机回北京，下个月来悉尼。
text.pinyin: Wǒ míngtiān zuò fēijī huí Běijīng, xià gè yuè lái Xīní.
text.english: Tomorrow I'm flying back to Beijing, and next month I'm coming to Sydney.

text.hanzi: 小明，你的朋友在外边找你。
text.pinyin: Xiǎomíng, nǐ de péngyou zài wàibian zhǎo nǐ.
text.english: Xiaoming, your friend is outside looking for you.

text.hanzi: 我朋友明天坐火车来悉尼，我去找他玩。
text.pinyin: Wǒ péngyou míngtiān zuò huǒchē lái Xīní, wǒ qù zhǎo tā wán.
text.english: My friend is coming to Sydney by train tomorrow, and I'm going to catch up with him.

question.hanzi: 他朋友明天怎么来悉尼？
question.pinyin: Tā péngyou míngtiān zěnme lái Xīní?
question.english: How is his friend getting to Sydney tomorrow?

text.hanzi: 今天天气很好，不冷也不热。
text.pinyin: Jīntiān tiānqì hěn hǎo, bù lěng yě bú rè.
text.english: The weather's lovely today, neither cold nor hot.

text.hanzi: 我觉得这件衣服太大了，我想买那件小的。
text.pinyin: Wǒ juéde zhè jiàn yīfu tài dà le, wǒ xiǎng mǎi nà jiàn xiǎo de.
text.english: I think this top is too big. I want to buy the smaller one.

question.hanzi: 他觉得这件衣服怎么样？
question.pinyin: Tā juéde zhè jiàn yīfu zěnmeyàng?
question.english: What does he think of this top?

text.hanzi: 我弟弟是小学生，他会写一百个汉字。
text.pinyin: Wǒ dìdi shì xiǎoxuéshēng, tā huì xiě yì bǎi gè Hànzì.
text.english: My younger brother is at primary school. He can write a hundred characters.

question.hanzi: 他弟弟会写多少个汉字？
question.pinyin: Tā dìdi huì xiě duōshao gè Hànzì?
question.english: How many characters can his younger brother write?

text.hanzi: 上午的课十一点下课，下午两点上课。
text.pinyin: Shàngwǔ de kè shí yī diǎn xiàkè, xiàwǔ liǎng diǎn shàngkè.
text.english: The morning class finishes at eleven, and the afternoon class starts at two.

question.english: What time does the afternoon class start?

text.hanzi: 我们今天学了二十个新字。
text.pinyin: Wǒmen jīntiān xué le èr shí gè xīn zì.
text.english: We learnt twenty new characters today.

question.hanzi: 他们今天学了多少个新字？
question.pinyin: Tāmen jīntiān xué le duōshao gè xīn zì?
question.english: How many new characters did they learn today?

text.hanzi: 我喜欢在手机上看电影，不喜欢去电影院。
text.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan zài shǒujī shàng kàn diànyǐng, bù xǐhuan qù diànyǐngyuàn.
text.english: I like watching films on my phone. I don't like going to the cinema.

question.pinyin: Tā xǐhuan zài nǎr kàn diànyǐng?
question.english: Where does he like to watch films?

text.hanzi: 安娜可以说汉语，还能写一点儿汉字。
text.pinyin: Ānnà kěyǐ shuō Hànyǔ, hái néng xiě yìdiǎnr Hànzì.
text.english: Anna can speak Chinese, and she can write a few characters as well.

text.hanzi: 这个电影很好看，我还想看。
text.pinyin: Zhège diànyǐng hěn hǎokàn, wǒ hái xiǎng kàn.
text.english: This film is really good. I want to watch it again.

text.hanzi: 喂，张女士，您明天上午有时间吗？我想问您几个问题。
text.pinyin: Wèi, Zhāng nǚshì, nín míngtiān shàngwǔ yǒu shíjiān ma? Wǒ xiǎng wèn nín jǐ gè wèntí.
text.english: Hello, Ms Zhang. Are you free tomorrow morning? I'd like to ask you a few questions.

question.english: What does he want to do?

text.hanzi: 我正在看电视，不知道外边下雨了。
text.pinyin: Wǒ zhèngzài kàn diànshì, bù zhīdào wàibian xià yǔ le.
text.english: I'm watching TV, so I didn't know it had started raining outside.

text.hanzi: 我知道王先生的电话，不知道他的家在哪儿。
text.pinyin: Wǒ zhīdào Wáng xiānsheng de diànhuà, bù zhīdào tā de jiā zài nǎr.
text.english: I know Mr Wang's phone number, but I don't know where he lives.

text.pinyin: Wáng xiānsheng de jiā zài nǎr

text.hanzi: 我生病了，今天不去上班，要去医院看病。
text.pinyin: Wǒ shēngbìng le, jīntiān bú qù shàngbān, yào qù yīyuàn kànbìng.
text.english: I'm sick. I'm not going to work today; I'm going to the hospital to see a doctor.

text.hanzi: 我听见外边有人叫小王，小王不在，他去上班了。
text.pinyin: Wǒ tīngjiàn wàibian yǒu rén jiào Xiǎo Wáng, Xiǎo Wáng bú zài, tā qù shàngbān le.
text.english: I heard someone outside calling for Xiao Wang, but he isn't here; he's gone to work.

text.hanzi: 你不要在房间里和车里吃东西，去外边吃吧。
text.pinyin: Nǐ búyào zài fángjiān lǐ hé chē lǐ chī dōngxi, qù wàibian chī ba.
text.english: Don't eat in the room or in the car. Go and eat outside.
